analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.check: Have I made sense of the text and found in what sense it is true?
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.quote: The faithful reader of a canonical book is obliged to make sense out of it

analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.title: Consult the authority
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.action: If you cannot make sense of a canonical text yourself, go to someone who can and accept their resolution.
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.check: Have I consulted the recognized interpreter when stuck?
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.quote: If he cannot do this by himself, he is obliged to go to someone who can.

analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.title: Reading without freedom
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.action: Understand that canonical reading trades freedom of judgment for a special satisfaction.
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.check: Am I reading freely here, or under an obligation to agree?

analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.title: Notice when you read canonically
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.action: Notice when you must read canonically, as for bar exams or a professor's required interpretation.
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.check: Am I reading this text to match an authorized interpretation?
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.quote: have approached the situation in which we must read canonically.

analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.title: Scripture is hardest
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.action: Recognize that reading the Holy Book, if you believe it is the Word of God, is the most difficult problem in reading.
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.check: Am I giving this text the care its difficulty demands?
analytical/how-to-read-philosophy/how-to.quote: is the most difficult problem in the whole field of reading.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: Spot interpretation in news
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Notice when journalism mixes facts with interpretation and analysis that draw on social science concepts.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: Which parts of this piece are fact, and which social-science interpretation?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.quote: Journalists, much more commonly, enmesh the facts in interpretation, commentary, analysis of the news.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: Note borrowed ideology
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Recognize that much social criticism borrows its ideology and language from the social sciences.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: Whose social-science vocabulary is this book borrowing?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.quote: Much of this literature borrows its ideology and language from the social sciences.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: Social-science fiction
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Recognize fiction that builds artificial models of society as drawing on and spreading social science.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: Is this story a model of society carrying a social-science message?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.quote: Here the aim is to create artificial models of society

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.title: The core social sciences
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.action: Treat anthropology, economics, politics and sociology as the core of social science.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.check: Does this book belong to one of the core fields?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.quote: Such fields as anthropology, economics, politics, and sociology constitute a kind of central core of social science

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.title: The wider fringe
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.action: Include much of law, education and public administration, some business and social service, and much psychology within social science.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.check: Does this work in law, education or psychology count as social science?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.quote: together with a considerable portion of psychological literature, falls within the confines of a reasonable definition.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.title: Departments versus professional schools
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.action: Distinguish disciplines pursuing systematic knowledge of society from professional schools that train for practice.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.check: Is this work aimed at knowledge of society or at professional training?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.quote: the main purpose of such schools is to train for professional work outside of the university

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.title: Interdisciplinary studies need sophistication
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.action: Expect interdisciplinary reports to demand sophistication even to discern their strands, let alone judge their findings.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.check: Can I tell which specialties feed into this report's conclusions?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.quote: Considerable sophistication is required even to discern the various strands of these efforts

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.title: Is psychology social science
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.action: Decide whether a psychological work is individual (biological) or social, given the individual's inseparability from society.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.check: Is this psychology about the individual alone, or about the social environment?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.quote: the inseparability of the individual from his social environment.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.title: Behavioral sciences
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.action: Understand behavioral science as stressing observable, measurable behavior that yields verifiable findings.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.check: Are the findings here based on observable, measurable behavior?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.quote: The accent on behavior served to emphasize observable, measurable behavior

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.title: History versus social science
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.action: Distinguish history, an account of particular events, from social science, which seeks patterns or laws of behavior.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.check: Is this work recounting particulars, or seeking general laws?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/wh.quote: it is not a science in the sense that of itself it yields systematic knowledge of patterns or laws of behavior and development.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: Familiar data deceive
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Beware that familiar data and a narrative style make social science seem easier to read than it is.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: Am I mistaking familiarity for understanding?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.quote: The data are often drawn from experiences familiar to the reader

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: Question familiar jargon
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Do not assume you understand social science jargon just because you use it daily.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: Can I define this jargon term, or do I only recognize it?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.quote: we have all become familiar with the jargon of social science and use it often.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.mistake: Assuming everyday jargon has a clear meaning.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: Pin down chameleon words
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Pin down what broad words like "society" and "social" mean in each use.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: What exactly does "society" mean in this passage?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.quote: What a chameleon-like word it is

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: What are social problems
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Ask what you, or the author, actually mean by phrases like "social problems".
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: Can I say what "social" adds that "political" and "economic" do not?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.quote: But what did you, or the author, mean by social problems?

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: Deceptively easy reading
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Recognize that jargon, metaphors and strong feeling make social science deceptively easy reading.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: Is the writing's feeling or metaphor carrying me past unclear ideas?

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.title: Notice your strong opinions
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.action: Notice that you likely hold strong opinions on the matters social science treats, unlike most philosophical questions.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.check: What do I already believe about this subject before reading?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/th.quote: But on matters with which social science deals, we are likely to have strong opinions.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Check opinions at the door
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Set aside your commitments while outlining and interpreting, so you can hear what the book says.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Did I state what the author says before reacting with my own view?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: you must, as it were, check your opinions at the door.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.mistake: Refusing to hear the book out of loyalty to one's views.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Hear what it says
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Listen to what the book is saying; you cannot understand a book you refuse to hear.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Could I summarize the author's view fairly, even if I reject it?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: You cannot understand a book if you refuse to hear what it is saying.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Standing apart is not disloyal
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Stand apart and question what you read impersonally, even if it feels disloyal to your commitments.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Am I questioning this impersonally, or defending a side?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: Many readers fear that it would be disloyal to their commitment to stand apart and impersonally question what they are reading.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Watch for misused terms
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Check whether the author uses key technical terms, such as GNP, in their proper limited sense; his confusion becomes yours.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Is the author stretching this technical term beyond its proper meaning?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: if the writer of something you are reading is confused about his use of a key term, you, as reader, must be so, too.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Stipulated usage
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Look for where an author stipulates his usage: which terms are essential and how he will use them.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Has the author told me his essential terms and how he uses them?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: he informs you what terms are essential to his argument and how he is going to use them.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Accept hard-science stipulations
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Accept a hard scientist's stipulated definitions and postulates as rules of the game, and go on from there.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Am I disputing definitions I should simply accept?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: you do not dispute a hard scientist’s stipulations in reading his book.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Expect shifting social terms
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Expect social scientists to struggle with terms like "depression" or "mental health" throughout, and track their usage closely.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Has the author's use of this key term held steady?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: the social scientist must continue to struggle with his own terms throughout his work

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: A mixed kind
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Recognize social science as a mixture of science, philosophy and history, often with some fiction.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Which kinds of writing are mixed in this book?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: Much social science is a mixture of science, philosophy, and history, often with some fiction thrown in for good measure.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Identify the strands
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Identify the various strands that make up the social science work you are reading.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Can I name which parts are science, philosophy, history or fiction?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: the reader is confronted with the task of identifying the various strands that go to make up what he is reading.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Strands shift within books
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Watch for the mixture changing from book to book and within a single book.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Has the book shifted from one kind of writing to another?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: These strands may change in the course of a single book as well as in different books.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Classifying is the key task
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Answer "What kind of book is this?" first; for social science it is the first and most important task.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Have I worked out what kind of book this is before going further?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: It is not only his first task, but also his most important.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Outline as usual
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Outline a social science work as you would any expository book; it poses no special problems.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Can I outline the book's major parts?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: Outlining a work in social science poses no special problems

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Reach common understanding of terms
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Work toward a common understanding of key terms, even when the author cannot stipulate them precisely.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Do the author and I share an understanding of each key term?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: Nevertheless, some common understanding of the key terms is usually possible.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Restraint on What of it
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: Exercise considerable restraint when asking "What of it?" of a social science book.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Is my judgment of significance driven by argument or by prior commitments?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: But the last question, What of it?, requires considerable restraint on the part of the reader.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.title: Can't fault yet disagree
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.action: If you cannot fault the conclusions but still disagree, recognize your prejudgments are at work.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.check: Do I disagree without being able to say where the author went wrong?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.quote: “I cannot fault the author’s conclusions, but I nevertheless disagree with them.”
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/di.mistake: Disagreeing from prejudgment without showing any defect.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.title: Read several books
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.action: Read several books on a social science subject rather than one book for its own sake.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.check: Have I read more than one work on this subject?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.quote: it is customary in social science to read several books about a subject rather than one book for its own sake.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.title: Focus on the problem
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.action: Organize your reading around a particular matter or problem, such as law enforcement, rather than one author.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.check: What problem am I reading about, across authors?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.quote: we often have our eye primarily on a particular matter or problem, rather than on a particular author or book.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.title: No single authoritative work
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.action: Do not expect one authoritative work on a social science subject; read several.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.check: Am I relying on one book as if it settled the subject?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.quote: Typically, there is no single, authoritative work on any of these subjects, and we must therefore read several.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.title: Check currency
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.action: Check editions and dates, since newer social science works rapidly supersede older ones.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.check: Is this the latest edition, or has newer work superseded it?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.quote: new works supersede older ones and rapidly render them obsolete.

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.title: Read the author's influences
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.action: To understand a philosopher fully, read the philosophers your author read and was influenced by.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.check: Have I read the thinkers who shaped this author?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.quote: you should make some attempt to read the philosophers your author himself has read

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.title: Apply rules to each
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.action: Apply the analytical rules to each work you read on the subject.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.check: Have I read each book analytically before comparing them?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.quote: They apply to each of the works that is read, of course

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.title: Move to syntopical reading
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.action: Recognize that reading several works on one subject requires the new rules of syntopical reading.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.check: Am I comparing books with syntopical rules, not just analytical ones?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.quote: new rules of reading are required as we pass from the third level of reading (analytical reading), to the fourth (syntopical reading).

analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.title: Social science needs syntopical reading
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.action: Read social science syntopically; that need is why it closes Part Three.
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.check: Am I treating social science as a field to read across many books?
analytical/how-to-read-social-science/re.quote: Social science came last because of the need to read it syntopically.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Know several books apply
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Begin by recognizing that more than one book is relevant to your question; this is the first requirement of any syntopical project.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I confirmed that my question is treated by more than one book?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Knowing that more than one book is relevant to a particular question is the first requirement in any project of syntopical reading.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Know which books to read
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Work out, in a general way, which books should be read on the subject; expect this second requirement to be much harder than the first.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Do I have a reasoned idea of which books belong on my list, not just that some exist?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Knowing which books should be read, in a general way, is the second requirement.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Question “same subject”
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Do not assume books share a subject because they share a word or setting; ask whether they really treat the same subject.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Do these books genuinely address my subject, or merely use its word or background?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: What do we mean by “same subject”?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Treating books as on one subject because they share a word or setting.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Background is not subject
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Distinguish a subject that is merely the context or background of a novel from the subject the author actually rivets attention on.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Is the subject the book’s real concern, or only its backdrop?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: War provides the context or background of both stories
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Studying war through novels whose real concern is the story.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Map the range of reference
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: When a term like love is used across a vast range of reference, ask whether there is a single subject and what common meaning, if any, unites its uses.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I asked whether the different uses of the word share any common sense?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Can we even be sure that there is a single subject?

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Narrow the enquiry
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Faced with a chaotic range of meanings, limit the enquiry to a manageable part of the subject, while expecting a wide range of conceptions even then.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I narrowed my subject enough to be workable, and noted the conceptions still competing within it?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: you may decide to limit the enquiry to human love

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Paradox of syntopical reading
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Recognize that identifying the subject matter must, in a sense, follow the reading rather than precede it; be ready to discard works found off-subject.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I prepared to revise what my subject is, and drop books, as my reading proceeds?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: it is in a sense true that the identification of the subject matter must follow the reading, not precede it.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Fixing the subject firmly before reading anything.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Expect irrelevant works
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Expect that after much reading you may conclude that many of the works you read were not on the subject at all.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I been willing to judge some books on my list irrelevant?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: you might have to conclude that half of the works you had read were not on the subject at all.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Levels are cumulative
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Treat inspectional and analytical reading as preparations for syntopical reading, since a higher level includes all those below it.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I using my inspectional and analytical skills as tools within syntopical reading?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: both inspectional and analytical reading can be considered as anticipations or preparations for syntopical reading.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Use inspection as main tool
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Rely on inspectional reading as the major tool for handling a large bibliography in syntopical reading.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I using inspection to cope with the size of my bibliography?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: It is here, in fact, that inspectional reading comes into its own as a major tool or instrument for the reader.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Don’t read all analytically
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Do not try to read every book on a large bibliography analytically; it could take years, so use a short cut.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I avoided committing to an analytical reading of every title?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: to read a hundred books analytically might well take you ten years.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Reading a hundred books analytically before knowing which matter.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Inspect all books first
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Once you have amassed your bibliography, inspect all of the books on it before reading any of them analytically.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Did I inspect every book on my list before starting analytical reading of any?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: You should not read any of them analytically before inspecting all of them.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Starting deep reading of one book before surveying the whole list.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Inspection clarifies subject
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Use the inspection of all books to get a clear enough idea of your subject that later analytical reading of some of them is productive.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: After inspecting, can I state my subject clearly enough to read further with purpose?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: it will give you a clear enough idea of your subject so that your subsequent analytical reading of some of the books on the list is productive.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Cut down the bibliography
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Use inspection to cut your bibliography down to a more manageable size.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Is my list now shorter and limited to books that matter to my subject?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: it will allow you to cut down your bibliography to a more manageable size.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Vary time per book
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Do not spend the same time and effort on every book or article; give more to books that deserve it and less to the rest.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I reading some books faster than others according to their worth to my subject?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: They spend the same amount of time and effort on every book or article they read.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Spending equal time on every book.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Decide: return or not
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: While inspecting each book, decide whether it says something important about your subject and must be returned to, or contains no enlightenment.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: For each book, have I decided whether I must return to it for light?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Either the book is one to which he must return for light, or it is one that, no matter how enjoyable or informative, contains no enlightenment

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Don’t merge inspection steps
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Do not try to inspect all the books concurrently with reading them analytically; keep these two steps separate, however skillful you are.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Did I finish inspecting before starting analytical reading, rather than doing both at once?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Thinking they can collapse these two steps into one, they end up reading everything at the same rate
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Collapsing inspection and analytical reading into one pass.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Aim differs from analysis
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Remember that analytical reading aims at understanding a single book, whereas syntopical reading has a quite different aim.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I reading for my problem across books, not for understanding one book for its own sake?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: the art of analytical reading applies to the reading of a single book, when understanding of that book is the aim in view.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Take all five steps
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Take all five steps of syntopical reading; if any is omitted, syntopical reading becomes much harder, perhaps impossible.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I carried out every one of the five steps?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: if any of the steps is not taken, syntopical reading becomes much more difficult, perhaps impossible.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Find the relevant passages
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Inspect again the whole works identified as relevant, to find the passages most germane to your needs.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I located the specific passages in each book that bear on my problem?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Your aim is to find the passages in the books that are most germane to your needs.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Put your problem first
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Put your problem first and the individual books second; the books are there to serve you and your concerns.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I serving my problem, or getting absorbed in each book for its own sake?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: In syntopical reading, it is you and your concerns that are primarily to be served, not the books that you read.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Placing the individual books ahead of your own problem.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Read quickly for purpose
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Even if a whole book is on your subject, read it quickly, remembering you read it for the light it throws on your own problem.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I keeping my ulterior purpose in view rather than reading the book for its own sake?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: you should read the book quickly.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Keep steps separate early
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: At the beginning of a project, keep finding relevant passages separate from deciding which books are relevant; merge them only with later books.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: For my early books, did I identify relevant books before hunting for passages?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: But at the beginning, they should be kept rigorously separated.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Identifying passages while still identifying books, causing mistakes and wasted effort.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Later books: combine steps
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: With books you reach after reading many others, when your problem is clear, you may combine judging relevance and finding passages.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Is my problem clear enough now that I can safely combine the two steps?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: In the case of the later books, you probably already have a fairly clear idea of your problem, and in that case the two steps can coalesce.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Use books beyond intent
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Look for how a book can be useful to you, even in a connection far from the author’s own purpose in writing it.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I asked how this passage helps my problem, regardless of the author’s intention?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The author can help you to solve your own problem without having intended to.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Be master, not disciple
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: In syntopical reading, act as master of the situation rather than as disciple to master, as you do in analytical reading.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I directing the reading, or deferring to one author’s framing?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: When you read syntopically, you must be the master of the situation.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Bring authors to terms
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Establish the terms yourself and bring your authors to them, rather than coming to terms with each author in his own words.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I set my own terms and translated each author into them?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Thus it is you who must establish the terms, and bring your authors to them rather than the other way around.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Force authors into your language
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Make each author use your language instead of his own, despite the habit of deferring to the author’s terms; this is the hardest step.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I expressing every author’s views in my vocabulary rather than his?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: What it really comes down to is forcing an author to use your language, rather than using his.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Refuse one author’s terms
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Resolutely refuse to adopt any one author’s terminology, or you will understand his book but fail to understand the others.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I avoided adopting any single author’s vocabulary as my framework?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: In syntopical reading, however, we will very quickly be lost if we accept any one author’s terminology.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Adopting one author’s terminology and organization of the subject.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Beware shared vocabulary
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Accept that no author’s terminology may be useful; treat any coincidence between your terms and an author’s as accidental and possibly inconvenient.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: If I borrowed an author’s term, has it pulled in his other terms and distorted my analysis?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: we must accept the fact that coincidence of terminology between us and any of the authors on our list is merely accidental.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Borrowing one term of an author and then sliding into his whole vocabulary.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Reading as translation
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Treat syntopical reading as an exercise in translation: impose a common terminology on authors who may not have addressed your problem.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I translated each author’s views into one common terminology?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Syntopical reading, in short, is to a large extent an exercise in translation.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Build a set of terms
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Build up a set of terms that helps you understand all of your authors, not just a few, and that helps you solve your problem.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Does my terminology fit all the authors and serve my problem?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: a set of terms that first, helps us to understand all of our authors, not just one or a few of them, and second, helps us to solve our problem.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Get the questions clear
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Establish neutral propositions by framing a set of questions that shed light on your problem and to which each author gives answers.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I written questions that all or most authors can be read as answering?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The best way to do this is to frame a set of questions that shed light on our problem, and to which each of our authors gives answers.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Questions serve two aims
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: State and order the questions so they help solve your problem and so that most authors can be interpreted as answering them.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Do my questions both advance my problem and fit most authors?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The questions must be stated in such a way and in such an order that they help us to solve the problem we started with

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Authors may not see question
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Expect that the questions you want answered may not have been seen as questions by the authors, whose view of the subject may differ.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I allowed for authors who never framed my question as a question?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The difficulty is that the questions we want answered may not have been seen as questions by the authors.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Record silent authors
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: When an author gives no answer to a question, record him as silent or indeterminate on it.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I marked authors who do not answer a question as silent or indeterminate?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: In that case, we must record him as silent or indeterminate on the question.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Find implicit answers
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Where an author does not discuss a question explicitly, look for an implicit answer he would have given had he considered it.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I checked each book for implicit answers, not only explicit statements?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: But even if he does not discuss the question explicitly, we can sometimes find an implicit answer in his book.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Exercise restraint
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Exercise restraint when inferring implicit answers; do not put thoughts into authors’ minds or words into their mouths.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Can I support each implicit answer I attribute from the author’s text?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Restraint is necessary here; we cannot put thoughts into our authors’ minds, or words into their mouths.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Inventing answers an author never implied.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Order the questions
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Order questions usefully: first the existence or character of the idea, then how it is known or manifested, then the consequences of earlier answers.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Does my sequence go from existence/character, to how known, to consequences?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The first questions usually have to do with the existence or character of the phenomenon or idea we are investigating.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Expect differing answers
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Do not expect authors to answer your questions the same way; their disagreements are what lead to the next step.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I noted where authors answer my questions differently?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: We should not expect that all of our authors will answer our questions in the same way.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Define the issues
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Where a clear question is answered differently by different authors, define the issue between those who answer one way and those who answer otherwise.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: For each question, have I stated the issue and which authors stand on each side?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: If a question is clear, and if we can be reasonably certain that authors answer it in different ways—perhaps pro and con—then an issue has been defined.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Order multiple answers
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: When more than two answers are given, order the opposing answers in relation to one another and classify authors by their views.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I arranged the several answers relative to each other and grouped authors under them?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: the opposing answers must be ordered in relation to one another, and the authors who adopt them classified according to their views.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: A truly joined issue
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Check that an issue is truly joined: two authors understanding the question the same way must answer it in contrary or contradictory ways.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Do the opposed authors understand the question in the same way?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: An issue is truly joined when two authors who understand a question in the same way answer it in contrary or contradictory ways.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Mistaking different conceptions of the question for genuine disagreement.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Frame issues to join them
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Define issues so they are joined as well as may be, even framing the question in a way no author explicitly uses.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I reframed questions where needed so the disagreement is genuine?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Sometimes this forces him to frame the question in a way that is not explicitly employed by any author.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Group issues into controversies
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Group connected issues around closely related questions into controversies, and sort and arrange each controversy in an orderly, perspicuous way.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I grouped related issues into controversies and laid them out clearly?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: A number of issues revolving around a closely connected set of questions may be termed the controversy about that aspect of the subject.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Analyze the discussion
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Having defined the issues, analyze the discussion as a whole, asking of it questions like Is it true? and What of it?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I moved from defining issues to assessing the whole discussion?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: In the case of syntopical reading, we are now prepared to address ourselves to similar questions about the discussion.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Parallels analytical stages
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Note that steps one to four parallel the first two groups of analytical rules (what it says, how), and step five parallels criticism.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Can I answer what the discussion says and how before judging it?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The first four steps correspond to the first two groups of rules for analytical reading.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Seek truth in the conflict
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: For perennial problems, do not expect truth in one set of answers; look for it in the conflict of opposing answers.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I avoided presuming one set of answers holds the whole truth?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Rather, it is to be found, if at all, in the conflict of opposing answers
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Presuming the truth lies in a single set of answers.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Truth as ordered discussion
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Treat the solution, insofar as available, as lying in the ordered discussion itself rather than in any set of propositions about it.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I produced an ordered discussion, not just a list of my own conclusions?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: consists rather in the ordered discussion itself than in any set of propositions or assertions about it.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Ask and defend an order
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Ask the questions in a certain order and be able to defend that order.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Can I justify why my questions come in this sequence?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: We have to ask them in a certain order, and be able to defend that order

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Show and explain differences
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Show how the questions are answered differently, and try to say why.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I shown each divergent answer and attempted to explain the divergence?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: we must show how the questions are answered differently and try to say why

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Point to supporting texts
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Be able to point to the texts in the books examined that support your classification of answers.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Can I cite the passage that places each author where I put him?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: we must be able to point to the texts in the books examined that support our classification of answers.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Only then claim understanding
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Claim to have analyzed and understood the discussion only after ordering, explaining and documenting it in full.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I done all three: defended order, explained differences, cited texts?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Only when we have done all of this can we claim to have analyzed the discussion of our problem.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Prepare ground for others
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Aim for an analysis thorough enough to clear away deadwood and lay groundwork for further productive work by others.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Would my analysis help another thinker see the dimensions of the problem?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: It can clear away the deadwood and prepare the way for an original thinker to make a breakthrough.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Report the major issues
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Make your analysis identify and report the major issues, or basic intellectual oppositions, in the discussion.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Does my analysis name the basic oppositions in the discussion?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: An adequate analysis of the discussion of a problem or subject matter identifies and reports the major issues, or basic intellectual oppositions, in that discussion.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Note agreement too
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Record agreement as well as disagreement; most positions are shared by several authors, seldom by a solitary exponent.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I shown which authors share each position, not just where they clash?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: agreement in most cases accompanies disagreement

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Agreement vs disagreement
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Treat agreement as a presumption of truth and disagreement as a counter-presumption that no conflicting opinion may be wholly true.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I weighed what agreement and disagreement each suggest about truth?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: But their disagreement establishes the counter-presumption—that none of the opinions in conflict, whether shared or not, may be wholly true.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Keep the truth open
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Allow that one opinion may be wholly true, each may hold part of the truth, all may be false, or an unexpressed opinion may be nearer the truth.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I kept open the possibility that the truth is partial, shared, or not yet stated?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Some opinion as yet unexpressed may be the truth or nearer to it.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Don’t pronounce verdicts
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Do not assert or try to prove the truth or falsity of any view on the issues; that makes the analysis dogmatic, one more voice.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I refrained from declaring any side right or wrong in my report?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: It would be dogmatic, not dialectical, if, on any of the important issues that it identified and analyzed, it asserted or tried to prove
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Becoming one more partisan voice, losing detachment.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Dialectical objectivity
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Aim at dialectical objectivity: be resolutely objective and detached throughout the analysis.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Was I detached and objective at every stage, not just in conclusions?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The special quality that a syntopical analysis tries to achieve can, indeed, be summarized in the two words “dialectical objectivity.”

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: All sides, no sides
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Try to look at all sides and to take no sides, presenting issues without prejudice and treating opposing views impartially.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I covered every side I can find, and favoured none?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The syntopical reader, in short, tries to look at all sides and to take no sides.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Keep trying for all sides
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Keep trying to enumerate all sides of an issue, though you will fail; taking no sides is easier than looking at all sides.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I searched for sides of the issue I may have missed?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: All possible sides of an issue cannot be exhaustively enumerated. Nevertheless, he must try.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Thinking objectivity is achieved merely by not taking sides.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Watch subtle partiality
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Guard against partiality in how you summarize arguments, in emphasis and neglect, in the tone of questions or remarks, and in the order of answers.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Do my summaries, emphasis, tone and ordering favour any side?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Partiality can intrude in a variety of subtle ways—by the manner in which arguments are summarized, by shades of emphasis and neglect
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Avoiding explicit verdicts while slanting summaries, emphasis, tone or order.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Reread the actual text
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Constantly refer back to the actual text of your authors, reading the relevant passages over and over.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I checked my interpretation against the passages repeatedly?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: he must constantly refer back to the actual text of his authors, reading the relevant passages over and over

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Quote the author’s words
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: When presenting results, quote each author’s opinion or argument in his own language, alongside your neutral-terminology summary.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Does each summary come with a quotation so readers can judge my interpretation?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: he must quote the opinion or argument of an author in the writer’s own language.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Summaries neutral, quotes in context
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Present summaries in your neutral language, and quote the author carefully without wrenching words out of context.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Are my summaries in neutral terms and my quotations faithful to context?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: the author’s own words, carefully quoted so as not to wrench them out of context, must accompany the summary
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Quoting out of context, or summarizing in the author’s own terms.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Balance and restrain comment
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Deliberately balance question against question, forgo prejudicial comment, and check any over- or underemphasis.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I balanced questions and cut prejudicial comments and lopsided emphasis?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: That ideal demands a deliberate effort to balance question against question, to forgo any comment that might be prejudicial

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Judge your own objectivity
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Hold yourself responsible for objectivity; only you, the syntopical reader, can know whether you met these requirements.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Honestly, have I met the demands of dialectical objectivity?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: only the syntopical reader himself—can know whether he has satisfied these requirements.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Amass by inspection
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Amass your bibliography through a series of inspectional readings of many more works than end up on the list.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Did I inspect a far larger pool to build my final list?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: This task was accomplished by a series of inspectional readings of several times that many books, articles, and other pieces.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Look beyond titles
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Do not rely only on books with your subject’s word in the title; many relevant works, especially older ones, do not use the term.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I sought relevant works that never use my keyword?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: most of the older books, although relevant to the subject, do not even employ the term.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Searching only for the subject word in titles.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Prefer expository works
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Generally concentrate on expository works; abstain from placing novels, plays and poems on issues, since results are dubious.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I mostly limited my project to expository works?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The effort is so great, and the results essentially so dubious, that usually it is prudent to abstain.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Why fiction resists
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Remember that a story’s essence is plot, characters rarely take clear positions, and a character’s speech may not be the author’s view.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Is this character’s speech really the author’s position, or irony?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: First of all, the backbone or essence of a story is its plot, not its positions on issues.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Treating a character’s speech as the author’s view.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Rename minority usage
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: When authors use a key word in incompatible senses, keep it for the majority sense and give the minority view a different neutral name.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I avoided using one word for incompatible conceptions?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: the minority faction had to be referred to as authors who assert “non-meliorative advance” in history.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Find the primary question
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Identify the primary question to which all authors can be read as answering, and sort its answers, e.g. Yes, No, We cannot know.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: What is the first question every author can be read as answering?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: The first question to ask, the question to which authors can be interpreted as giving various answers, is, Does progress occur in history?

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: General vs special controversy
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Distinguish a general controversy, joined by all authors, from a special controversy joined only by those who accept a basic answer.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I separated issues all authors join from issues only one camp joins?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: But there is also a special controversy about progress, which is made up of issues that are joined only by progress authors

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Identify subordinate issues
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Identify subordinate issues about the respects or areas in which the thing is said to occur.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I mapped the areas in which authors affirm or deny the phenomenon?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Finally, there is a set of subordinate issues, as we called them

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Always define and analyze
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Always define the issues and analyze the discussion, even if you do not write a long book reporting your research.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I structured the issues and discussion even for a modest project?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: And something like this must always be done by a syntopical reader

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: The fundamental problem
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Recognize the fundamental problem: without knowing where to start you cannot read syntopically, and finding passages may take longer than all other steps.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Do I have a real starting point for finding relevant books and passages?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Unless you know what books to read, you cannot read syntopically, but unless you can read syntopically, you do not know what to read.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Beware expert guidance
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Be cautious when an expert directs you to passages; he may tell you how to read them, or know less than he seems to.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Has my adviser told me where to look without prejudging what it means?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: his advice might turn out to be almost as much a hindrance as a help.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.mistake: Letting an adviser’s interpretation shape your reading of the passages.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Use an unbiased index
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Use a reference work that tells you where relevant passages are without saying how they should be read.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Does my finding aid point to passages without prejudging their meaning?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: without prejudging their meaning or significance.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Start with the Syntopicon
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Use the Syntopicon, a topical index to Great Books of the Western World, as at least a place to start any syntopical project.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I checked the Syntopicon’s topic for my subject as a starting point?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Nevertheless, it always provides you with at least a place to start on any syntopical reading project.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Index covers one set
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Remember the Syntopicon indexes only one set of books and gives only rough guidance to others; extend your search beyond it.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I looked beyond the indexed set of books?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: It is an index of just one set of books (albeit a large one)

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Read in before through
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Begin the great books by reading short passages from many authors on a subject that interests you, before reading whole books.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I started on the great books through passages on my interest?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: It helps us to read in the great books before we have read through them.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Follow new interests
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Let reading on one subject lead you to related subjects, and explore the context of passages you start on.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Has my reading led me into related topics and wider context?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Starting from the reader’s existing interest in a particular subject, it may arouse or create other interests in related subjects.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Find the passage’s relevance
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Use the topic to direct your interpretation, but discover for yourself precisely what relevance the passage has to the topic.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Can I state exactly how this passage bears on the topic?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Hence the reader is called upon to discover precisely what relevance the passage has to the topic.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Read passages against each other
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Read passages from different works on the same topic against one another to sharpen your interpretation of each.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Has comparing contrasting passages clarified each one?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: the meaning of each of a series of contrasting or conflicting passages from different books is accentuated when they are read against one another.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Interpret passages multiply
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: When a passage is cited under several topics, interpret it differently in relation to each, training alertness to strains of meaning.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I read this passage in light of each topic it is cited under?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Such multiple interpretation not only is a basic exercise in the art of reading

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: syntopical vs Syntopical
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Distinguish syntopical reading in general from Syntopical reading of the great books with the Syntopicon; it is wise to start with the latter.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I used the Syntopicon as a first part of my wider project?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: perhaps it would always be wise to start there.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Objections to syntopical reading
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Know the objections: terminology is sacrosanct, authors are separate universes, and style matters more than subject.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Can I state and answer the three objections to syntopical reading?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: There are those who say that syntopical reading (in the broader sense just mentioned) is impossible.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Translation is possible
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Answer the objection to imposing terms by recognizing that translating between terminologies is difficult but not impossible.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Am I treating translation of terms as hard but doable?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: But the difficult is not the impossible.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Be the interpreter
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Act as interpreter through whom books can talk to one another, knowing both books as well as you can.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Do I know each author well enough to translate between them?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Care is required, of course, and you should know both “languages”—that is, both books—as well as you can.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Seek rational content
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Attend to what an author says, the objective rational content, not only how he says it.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I grasped what the author says, beyond reacting to his manner?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: You have understood what he said as well as reacting, no doubt in all sorts of ways, to how he said it.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Two main stages
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Proceed in two main stages: survey the field preparatory to syntopical reading, then do syntopical reading proper.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I finished surveying the field before reading syntopically?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: One is preparatory, and the other is syntopical reading proper.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Create tentative bibliography
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Create a tentative bibliography of your subject from library catalogues, advisors, and bibliographies in books.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I used catalogues, advisors and book bibliographies to build my list?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Create a tentative bibliography of your subject by recourse to library catalogues, advisors, and bibliographies in books.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Inspect the bibliography
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Inspect all books on the tentative bibliography to find which are germane and to get a clearer idea of the subject.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I inspected every listed book for relevance and subject clarity?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Inspect all of the books on the tentative bibliography to ascertain which are germane to your subject

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Let inspection revise list
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Let the two preparatory steps affect each other, using inspection to modify the bibliography.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Has inspection changed my bibliography?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: the two steps have an effect on each other, with the second, in particular, serving to modify the first.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Find most relevant passages
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Inspect the books identified as relevant in Stage I to find the most relevant passages.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I located the most relevant passages in each relevant book?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Inspect the books already identified as relevant to your subject in Stage I in order to find the most relevant passages.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Construct neutral terminology
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Bring the authors to terms by constructing a neutral terminology that all or most authors can be interpreted as employing.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Can all or most authors be read in my neutral terms, whether or not they use the words?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: whether they actually employ the words or not.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Frame neutral questions
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Establish neutral propositions by framing questions that all or most authors can be interpreted as answering, explicitly or not.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Can all or most authors be read as answering each question?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: Establish a set of neutral propositions for all of the authors by framing a set of questions

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Define major and minor issues
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Define major and minor issues by ranging authors’ opposing answers on sides, constructing issues by interpretation where not explicit.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Have I placed each author on a side, including constructed issues?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: an issue does not always exist explicitly between or among authors, but that it sometimes has to be constructed by interpretation

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Order questions and issues
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Analyze the discussion by ordering questions and issues to throw maximum light, general before less general, with relations clearly shown.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Do general issues come first, with relations among issues made clear?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: More general issues should precede less general ones, and relations among issues should be clearly indicated.

syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.title: Quote with every interpretation
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.action: Maintain dialectical detachment throughout; always accompany an interpretation of an author’s view with an actual quotation from his text.
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.check: Does every interpretation of an author carry a quotation from his text?
syntopical/the-fourth-level-of-reading-s.quote: One way to insure this is always to accompany an interpretation of an author’s views on an issue with an actual quotation from his text.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Activity is the essence
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Read as actively as you can, since the more active reading is, the better it is.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Was I actively asking questions as I read?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: We have shown that activity is the essence of good reading, and that the more active reading is, the better it is.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Active reading is questioning
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Ask the right questions of any book, answering them differently for different kinds of books.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Have I asked the required questions, adapted to this kind of book?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: We have defined active reading as the asking of questions

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Four cumulative levels
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Remember the four levels of reading are cumulative, with lower levels contained in higher ones.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Am I using the lower-level skills within the higher levels?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: earlier or lower levels being contained in later or higher ones.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Act on the book
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: If you accept the aim of reading as well as possible and the rules as fitting means, make the effort to read as never before.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Having accepted the aim and means, am I actually acting on them?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: then you must make the effort to read as you probably have never read before.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.mistake: Agreeing with a practical book without acting on it.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Method needs materials
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Pair the method of reading with the right materials, the books you read; one without the other is useless.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Am I applying the rules to books worth applying them to?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: Having a method without materials to which it can be applied is as useless as having the materials with no method to apply to them.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Read books over your head
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: To improve as a reader, tackle books that are beyond you, that make you stretch your mind.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Is this book beyond my current capacity?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: You must tackle books that are beyond you, or, as we have said, books that are over your head.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.mistake: Reading only books well within your capacity.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Stretch to learn
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Choose reading that makes you stretch, because unless you stretch you will not learn.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Did this book force me to stretch?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: Only books of that sort will make you stretch your mind. And unless you stretch, you will not learn.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Identify demanding books
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Learn to identify the books that make the demands on you that improvement in reading ability requires.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Can I tell which books will make real demands on me?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: to be able to identify those books that make the kinds of demands on you that improvement in reading ability requires.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Amusement doesn’t improve skill
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Do not expect anything but amusement from a book that only amuses; improvement in reading skill does not accompany it.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Am I reading this for amusement only, and do I know it?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: improvement in reading skill does not accompany it.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Information doesn’t stretch
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Do not mistake a mind fuller of facts for an improved one; reading for information does not stretch your mind.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Has this book increased my understanding, or only my stock of facts?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: Reading for information does not stretch your mind any more than reading for amusement.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.mistake: Confusing a quantitative gain in facts with growth in skill.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Don’t fear hard books
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Do not fear books that seem beyond you; apply the rules and no book is completely out of your grasp.
