general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Have I applied the rules before deciding a book is too hard?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: there is no book that is completely out of your grasp if you apply the rules of reading to it that we have described.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Seek books that keep extending
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Seek out books that continue to extend you however good a reader you become.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Does this book still challenge me as my skill grows?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: Actually, those are the very books that you must seek out

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Not only science is hard
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Do not suppose only scientific or philosophical books are challenging; poetical works lack scientific aids and may be the hardest.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Have I included imaginative works among my demanding reading?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: Homer, for example, is in many ways harder to read than Newton
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.mistake: Believing only scientific and philosophical books challenge the reader.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Bad book vs hard book
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Distinguish a good difficult book from a bad book, which is hard only because there is nothing to pin down; don’t struggle with it.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Is this book difficult because it is rich, or because it is empty?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: In fact, in the case of a bad book, there is really nothing to pin down.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Two rewards of good books
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Expect two rewards from a good, difficult book: improved reading skill and, more important, learning about the world and yourself.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Has this book improved my skill and made me wiser about life?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: You learn more than how to read better; you also learn more about life. You become wiser.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Read on unsolvable problems
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Use the greatest books to think better about problems that have no final solution, written by those who thought best about them.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Is this book helping me think better about enduring human questions?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: These are matters about which you cannot think too much, or too well.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Skim the 99 per cent
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Treat the vast majority of books as for amusement or information only; skim them rather than read them analytically.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Is this one of the books where skimming will do?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: In fact, you do not have to read them—analytically—at all. Skimming will do.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Read good books once
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Read the good books, which convey significant insights, analytically once, getting everything out of them in one good reading.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Have I given this good book one full analytical reading?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: They are worth reading analytically—once.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Keep notes for reference
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Make notes in good books so you can return to check points or refresh your memory without rereading.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Have I marked this book so I can revisit key points quickly?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: It is in the case of such books that the notes you make in the margin or elsewhere in the volume are particularly valuable.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Have I milked it dry?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Judge from your own mental reaction whether you have grasped a book entirely and it has nothing more to give you.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Do I sense this book will not change me any further?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: You have milked it dry.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Is there more there?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: After your best analytical reading, notice a sneaking suspicion that there is more in the book than you got; return to it.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Do I keep thinking about this book and suspect I missed something?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: you have a sneaking suspicion that there is more there than you got.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Go back for what you missed
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: If you know what you missed in a book, go back to it immediately to seek it out.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: If I know what I missed, have I gone back for it?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: If you knew what it was that you had missed, your obligation as an analytical reader would take you back to the book immediately to seek it out.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Rereading reveals the class
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: On rereading, note whether the book seems smaller (you outgrew it) or seems to have grown with you (an inexhaustible book).
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: On return, did the book seem less than remembered, or did I see whole new things?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: you discover on returning that the book seems to have grown with you.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Great books lift repeatedly
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Recognize a great book as one accessible at different levels, so far above you that it keeps lifting you on every return.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Does this book lift me again each time I return?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: it is accessible at different levels.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Find your own great books
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Seek out the few books that can have this lasting value for you personally, given your own tastes and powers.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Which handful of books do I want to return to over and over?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: you should seek out the few books that can have this value for you.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Desert island ten books
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Imagine being marooned on a desert island with only ten books, and decide which you would choose.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Which ten books would I take, and what does the choice reveal about me?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: You will also be allowed ten books. Which ones would you select?

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Find resources within
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Treat life as a desert island: find within yourself the resources to live a good human life.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Do I have inner resources that do not depend on outside stimulation?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: the challenge of finding the resources within ourselves to live a good human life.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: The mind can keep growing
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Keep developing your mind at every age; unlike the body, it has no fixed limit of growth.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Am I still growing in skill and understanding?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: But there is no limit to the amount of growth and development that the mind can sustain.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Exercise or atrophy
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Take regular mental exercise; the mind atrophies like the muscles if it is not used.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Am I exercising my mind, or relying on external demands?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: The mind can atrophy, like the muscles, if it is not used.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.mistake: Leaving mental activity to the demands of work alone.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Beware artificial props
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Do not rely on television, radio and other sources of amusement and information; they only seem to make the mind active and wear off like drugs.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Is my mind truly active, or just reacting to outside stimuli?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: Television, radio, and all the sources of amusement and information that surround us in our daily lives are also artificial props.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.mistake: Mistaking reaction to stimuli for genuine mental activity.

general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.title: Read well to keep growing
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.action: Read well, meaning actively, to keep your mind alive and growing.
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.check: Is my reading active enough to keep my mind growing?
general/reading-and-the-growth-of-the-mi.quote: Reading well, which means reading actively, is thus not only a good in itself
